feature1.prompt: The add filter is unable to concatenate strings with lazy strings because when a regular string is combined with a lazy string the result is an empty string and a TypeError is raised. The core of the problem lies in how lazy objects are handled during addition. The intended behavior is that lazy objects automatically cast themselves to the appropriate string or numeric value when used in an addition operation. This enhancement should ensure that any operation involving a lazy string and a normal string produces the correct concatenated result.
feature1.hint_texts: This feature focuses on enhancing the internal implementation of lazy objects. Ensure that the lazy object class supports addition operations by properly converting the lazy value using its __cast__ method. Examine the area where the __mod__ method is defined for guidance on implementing similar dunder methods. Specifically, add implementations for __add__ and __radd__ so that lazy objects interact seamlessly with standard types.
feature1.entrypoint: File: django/utils/functional.py – Add the __add__ and __radd__ methods within the lazy object implementation, near the existing __mod__ method.

feature2.prompt: The add filter in the templating system is unable to correctly concatenate lazy strings with regular strings. When a lazy string is used with the add filter, the expected concatenated string is not produced, resulting instead in an empty string or an exception. The fix must ensure that the add filter properly handles lazy strings by leveraging the correct casting of lazy values. In the end, combining a lazy string with another string using the add filter should yield the expected concatenated result without errors.
feature2.hint_texts: This feature addresses the presentation layer and focuses on the template rendering system. The add filter should now work correctly with lazy strings, meaning that the results of template concatenations reflect the underlying string values instead of causing errors. Verify that the template context correctly processes lazy string inputs by updating the test cases. Check the implementation of the add filter tests and confirm that lazy strings concatenate as expected.
feature2.entrypoint: File: tests/template_tests/filter_tests/test_add.py – Update or add test cases (specifically test_add08 and test_add09) to verify that the add filter handles lazy strings correctly in template rendering.

collaboration_points.shared_resources: Both features depend on the proper implementation and handling of lazy objects in django/utils/functional.py as well as the add filter mechanism in the templating system. The enhancements made in the lazy object arithmetic operations are a shared resource that the add filter builds upon.
collaboration_points.integration_strategy: Feature1 must implement the __add__ and __radd__ methods so that lazy objects can be correctly combined with other types. Feature2 then leverages these changes in the templating add filter tests. Developers working on these features should ensure that the updated lazy object behavior is fully integrated and properly consumed by the template filters.
collaboration_points.communication_needs: Developers should coordinate to confirm that any modifications in the lazy object implementation do not break existing functionalities in the template system. Regular communication is needed to discuss the interface contract between the core lazy object methods and the add filter. Both teams should review the integration points to ensure consistent behavior across the codebase.
